scope: Read-only visual audit of six figure sets, all four contribution tiers, both male/female variants.
reviewMethod: All six labelled 280×350-per-card sheets inspected; suspected Eumenes Rare and Nearchus female mismatches inspected at full840×1050. Anatomy judgments are visual composition assessments, not clinical claims.

rows.title: Pilot of the Indus Fleet
rows.reason: Chin lifts and turns away from the chart while pen remains on it, producing an upward neck emphasis. A pilot can observe the horizon, so this is a work-gaze improvement rather than a definite anatomical defect.
rows.recommendation: Bring chin down and eyes to the route on the chart; keep the sea-observation alternative only if the writing action pauses.
